salesInstructions.primaryGoal: Drive all leads to text or call our operations desk at +91 98301 84030 or message on WhatsApp.

salesInstructions.unanswerableQueryResponse: Yikes, my knowledge isn't as good as our explorers, perhaps try giving them a text or ring?

liveTourSchedules.name: In the Footsteps of the Raj (White Town Walk)
liveTourSchedules.timings: 07:00 AM - 10:00 AM (Apr - Sep) / 08:00 AM - 11:00 AM (Oct - Mar)
liveTourSchedules.meetingPoint: Outside Air India building, Central Avenue
liveTourSchedules.highlights: Dalhousie Square (B.B.D. Bagh), Writers' Building, General Post Office, St. John's Church, Job Charnock's 1695 Mausoleum

liveTourSchedules.name: The Star Still Shines (Born in Bengal / Black Town Walk)
liveTourSchedules.timings: 07:00 AM - 10:00 AM (Apr - Sep) / 08:00 AM - 11:00 AM (Oct - Mar)
liveTourSchedules.meetingPoint: Girish Park Metro Station Exit No. 1
liveTourSchedules.highlights: Sovabazar Rajbari 18th-century palatial courtyards, 19th-century zamindar mansions, authentic North Kolkata adda lanes, heritage sweet shops

liveTourSchedules.name: Bringing the Goddess to Earth (Potters' Trail & River Life)
liveTourSchedules.timings: 07:00 AM - 10:00 AM (Apr - Sep) / 08:00 AM - 11:00 AM (Oct - Mar)
liveTourSchedules.meetingPoint: Outside North Port Police Station, Strand Road
liveTourSchedules.highlights: Mullick Ghat Flower Market, Hooghly river wrestlers, Kumartuli idol-makers sculpting Goddess Durga from Ganga clay, traditional wooden country boat crossing

liveTourSchedules.name: Confluence of Cultures (The Melting Pot Walk)
liveTourSchedules.timings: 07:00 AM - 10:00 AM (Apr - Sep) / 08:00 AM - 11:00 AM (Oct - Mar)
liveTourSchedules.meetingPoint: Outside Air India building, Central Avenue
liveTourSchedules.highlights: Bow Barracks red-brick Anglo-Indian enclave, Armenian Church (1724), Magen David & Beth El Jewish Synagogues, Parsi Fire Temple, Chinese Temple, Nahoum & Sons bakery

liveTourSchedules.name: Dawn Calcutta Bicycle Tour
liveTourSchedules.schedule: Operates daily at sunrise (prior booking required)
liveTourSchedules.priceShared: ₹3,500 per person (~$42 USD) including premium geared bicycle & helmet
liveTourSchedules.highlights: Empty colonial boulevards at dawn, Maidan green lung, riverfront ghats, finishing with fresh kulhad chai and hot kachoris

liveTourSchedules.name: Cabin Food Walk
liveTourSchedules.schedule: Operates daily (flexible slot between 10:00 AM and 10:00 PM)
liveTourSchedules.timings: Flexible 3 hours (e.g. 11:30 AM - 02:30 PM or 05:00 PM - 08:00 PM)
liveTourSchedules.priceShared: ₹3,500 per person (~$42 USD) including all food tastings
liveTourSchedules.highlights: Indian Coffee House on College Street, historic wooden dining cabins, Mutton Kabiraji cutlets, fish fry, sweet kacha golla

liveTourSchedules.name: Cook as the Bongs Do (Bengali Cooking Experience)
liveTourSchedules.priceShared: ₹4,000 per person (~$48 USD) including market shopping, cooking session & multi-course family feast
liveTourSchedules.highlights: Local fish & mustard seed market shopping, hands-on cooking in a traditional Bengali home, Shorshe Maach, Kosha Mangsho, Luchi, Mishti Doi

liveTourSchedules.name: Sunset Country Boat Cruise
liveTourSchedules.highlights: Private wooden hand-oared country boat, gliding past Howrah Bridge and Vidyasagar Setu at sunset, evening Ganga aarti

bookingFAQ.groupSize: Strictly capped at maximum 8 walkers per shared departure for high intimacy and respectful local interaction.
bookingFAQ.whatIsIncluded: Expert local storyteller guide, traditional morning breakfast/snacks, bottled mineral water, wet wipes, and all heritage monument entrance fees.
bookingFAQ.customAndPrivate: Private departures on custom dates and times are happily accommodated. Call or WhatsApp +91 98301 84030.
bookingFAQ.howToBook: Guests can book via the Tours Calendar page on the website, or text/call WhatsApp at +91 98301 84030 for immediate confirmation.
